provenance.mode: position servos with bounded Twist integration

recommended_controller.name: holonomic_pose_follower
recommended_controller.evidence: Conservative configured gains for this simulated actuator bridge; physical route validation is recorded separately.

caveats: Simulation only. Unit gain follows the Twist-to-position integrator. Effective tau=0.25 selects conservative position feedback including the slew limiter; this is not a measured hardware plant fit.
Validated in this simulated house with the loaded five-bottle posture at up to 0.6 m/s, acceleration 0.4 m/s^2 and lateral acceleration 0.15 m/s^2. Approaches and turns slow down.
